title: RunConfiguration

concurrency_limit.description: Maximum number of active worker requests; must not exceed worker count.

description: This client-side contract contains request endpoints only. Controlled scenarios separately associate each entry with a simulated-worker configuration containing the same identity, delay, and behavior. Worker identities must be unique and concurrency_limit must be no greater than the number of workers; these cross-field rules are enforced only by RunConfiguration aggregate validation.
